adjudication.rationale: The diff does introduce an unbounded load/serialize of all embeddable hosts in `Admin::EmbeddingController#fetch_embedding` via `EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)` (used for both `show` and `update` through the `before_filter`). This is a concrete, diff-grounded performance/scalability concern (no pagination/limit) but it does not necessarily constitute a correctness defect given the endpoint is admin-only and intended to list hosts. The finding about `update` persisting nothing is also supported: `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` just re-renders the same serialized OpenStruct and the frontend calls `embedding.update({})` with empty props, suggesting the PUT is effectively a refresh/no-op.
